senses.gloss: (Tafel of רְעַע) to break, shatter, make a breach (corresp. to h. פָּרַץ, a. נָתַץ). Targ.
units: Targ. II Sam. VI, 8; a. fr.—Part. pass. תְּרִיעַ; f. תְּרִיעָא broken into, open.
